annotations.title: List the records of processing activities

description: Lists the records of processing activities (GDPR art. 30(1)) saved in the Hermetics account linked to the connection, in their latest version, with their full content. For an account of a Hermetics client organization, lists the organization's whole register on the Hermetics platform, whatever the origin of each record, with its status.
name: list_processing_records
title: List the records of processing activities
